newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strafor sees strong 97 oper profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Strafor sees strong 97 oper profit growth.

text.p: - Office furniture and hand tools manufacturer Strafor Facom expects "at least double-digit growth in operating profit" in 1997, chairman Henri Lachmann said in an interview to daily Le Figaro Monday.

The group's restructuring has included selling assets in steel manufacturing, shipyards and power tools, to concentrate on core activity in office furniture and hand-held tools and it plans to sell its stake in steelmaker Manoir Industrie in the next few months, he said.
Lachmann said splitting the group into two parts, furniture and tools, would do nothing for shareholder value and would run counter to group strategy.

Strafor Facom is seeking a broader international presence, he said, adding that his medium-term target was to boost the group's presence outside Europe to 25 percent of total sales from 16 percent at present.
He said his goal was to reduce the proportion of sales in Europe to 50 percent from 84 percent of total sales at present and to reduce sales inside France to 25 percent of the total from 42 percent.
